svg.title: SELECT: adverse events leading to discontinuation and gallbladder disorders
svg.desc: Permanent discontinuation due to any adverse event: 16.6% semaglutide vs 8.2% placebo. Due to gastrointestinal disorders: 10.0% vs 2.0%. Gallbladder-related disorders: 2.8% vs 2.3%. Source: Lincoff et al., NEJM 2023, Table 4.
